info.title: kac
info.description: Validator and generator for a knowledge-as-code corpus, driven by its own schema.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: kac — the knowledge-as-code validator and generator.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the summary and findings as JSON. [default: False]

commands.name: index
commands.description: Regenerate _index.md and the generated blocks in <type>.md.

options.name: --check
options.description: Fail if a generated file is stale instead of writing it. [default: False]

commands.name: export
commands.description: Write the corpus to .dist/export/ as a versioned export.

options.name: --type
options.description: Export one type rather than every type that contributes.

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Assemble the export and .plugin/ into a plugin under .dist/plugin/.

commands.name: checks
commands.description: List every check the validator implements.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the check catalogue as JSON. [default: False]

commands.name: mechanism
commands.description: Enforce the portability manifest: compare the shared layers against a reference, or take them from one.

options.name: --check
options.description: Compare the shared layers against a reference and report drift; never writes. [default: False]

options.name: --sync
options.description: Take the shared layers from the reference, then record what it took in .corpus.yaml. [default: False]

options.name: --against
options.description: Reference corpus (a path). Defaults to upstream.url in .corpus.yaml.
